prerequisites: Knowledge of rigid body mechanical analysis.
Knowledge of position, kinematic, and dynamic analysis of planar mechanisms.

learning_outcomes.text: Complete the student's training regarding the study of spatial mechanisms through the analysis of position, kinematics, and dynamics of manipulators.
Understanding and interpretation of texts and data, development of skills for their concretization and clear and concise presentation.
Ability to use scientific-technical tools for solving calculation and design problems in Industrial Engineering and aptitude for seeking sustainable engineering solutions.

syllabus_topics: Technical specifications of an industrial robot
Position analysis with an industrial robot
Process simulation with an industrial robot
teaching_methods: Guided practical activities (led by the professor)

assessment_methods.method: Written exams of general knowledge and problem solving

assessment_rules: The percentage corresponding to continuous assessment grades will be applied only if a minimum grade of 5 is obtained in the final evaluations. Assignments and practice reports must be completed and submitted by the student within the established deadlines throughout the course. Assessment criteria will be communicated in advance.
